auth.scope_note: Matches the loveleeday-connect consent screen (2026-10-05). gmail.readonly and all Drive scopes (including drive.metadata.readonly) are RESTRICTED and need a paid CASA assessment; not requested.

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Google OAuth app verification is required for sensitive or restricted scopes. Per Google: 'Apps that request access to scopes categorized as sensitive or restricted must complete Google's OAuth app verification.' Restricted-scope apps that can reach data through a third-party server must pass a CASA security assessment: 'Every app that requests access to Google users' restricted data and has the ability to access data from or through a third-party server must go through a security assessment.' Re-verify and reassess at least every 12 months after Letter of Assessment. Gmail read scopes and broad Drive read scopes are generally restricted (Google's Verification FAQ holds the authoritative list; not enumerated on pages fetched, so UNVERIFIED here).
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Workspace admin allowlists our OAuth client ID in Admin console > Security > API controls > App access control (UNVERIFIED page not fetched), or for domain-wide delegation authorizes our service account client ID and scopes. Until verified, unverified-app consent screen caps at 100 users (UNVERIFIED).
